ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ زَيْنِ الْمِلَاحِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Zayni ‘l-milāḥ.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family, adornment of the handsome!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ مَعْدِنِ الْجُوْدِ وَالسَّمَاحِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Ma`dini ‘l-jūdi wa ‘s-samāḥ.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family, fountain of generosity and magnanimity!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ مَا تَعَاقَبَ الْغُدُوُّ وَالرَّوَاحُ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Mā ta`āqaba ‘l-ghuduwwu wa ‘r-rawāḥ.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family whenever the day and night meet!
